_comment: 2026-11-01 EMGOR: the expression pedal is ALWAYS the NEPTR body port, never the DUODECIMUS treadle (both `when`s name a device that never exists, so body is always on, treadle always off). EXPRESSION PEDAL = presence-conditional source selection. The engine has ONE expression input
(ch1 CC29 as OSC /cc from the pool, soft takeover + gkLastToggle29 destination stay in expr_cc29.orc);
WHICH pedal feeds it is decided here by each profile's `when`, re-evaluated continuously (hotplug):
DUODECIMUS plugged in  -> its treadle (wire ch7 CC14 Jack-A / CC15 Jack-B)
DUODECIMUS not present -> the NEPTR body pedal (wire ch1 CC29, via the NEPTR Serial Bridge)
The engine ignores a ch1 CC29 that arrives on the MIDI wire; only the pool's /cc counts.
Arcade button b1 -> tempo TAP is a Teensy-serial source: inert unless demiurge-io owns the body's serial port
(on this rig neptr-bridge does, and sends the tap itself).
Install: NEPTR_phase4/pool/install_map.py merges these into ~/demiurge/sensors.json (rig-level maps, no patch header needed).
